headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while oil, inflation and geopolitical pressure sustain extreme Stress
body: Friday ended with a broad U.S. equity rebound and VIX at 15.59, while Brent settled above $104 and the U.S. 10-year yield approached 5%. Fresh supplementary Friday breadth remains constructive. With NQ closed, these macro and geopolitical factors raise Stress but do not establish persistent no-retracement structure.

lookbackSummary: From 01:00 UTC Friday through 00:00 UTC Saturday, Tail stayed mostly in WATCH through the inflation and U.S. session windows, eased into low late in the session, briefly returned to WATCH near the close, and finished low after weekly futures price discovery ended. Stress remained extreme.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain inside the weekend NQ futures closure. Tail stays low because no live price path can be observed; oil, inflation, Middle East shipping risk and next week's FOMC keep Stress extreme while reopening risk remains conditional.
